chapter_note: Strong substrate chapter on zodiac/stars cosmology. The substantive cosmological question (i=6-12) defines the teaching topic and belongs to substrate. Body (i=16-78) is dense cosmic mapping: 12 zodiac signs to 5 worlds of Darkness, the 5 stars (Zeus/Aphrodite/Ares/Hermes/Kronos) mapped to elemental worlds, anabibazons to Fire/Pleasure, sun/moon's economic role. Recap section (i=79-92) uses "I have shown/taught/revealed" markers but content is purely cosmological — these are pedagogical recap formulas of the teacher voice, kept largely as substrate. Title and dialogue frame openings are editorial. High teaching purity (0.832); negative fatigue score actually shows cosmological vocabulary decreasing in second half because that half is the recap with embedded didactic verbs.
